title: iGaming UI/UX Designer
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://ondeckglobal.com/

About the Role

We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer with a strong understanding of the iGaming industry to create engaging, intuitive, and visually compelling digital experiences.
You will be responsible for designing user-focused interfaces across online casino, sportsbook, betting, and gaming platforms, working closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to transform product requirements into seamless player experiences.
The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with UX thinking and understands how to design interfaces that are engaging, responsive, conversion-focused, and easy to navigate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design modern, high-quality UI/UX for iGaming websites, web apps, and mobile experiences.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces in Figma.
  • Design key iGaming experiences such as casino lobbies, sportsbook interfaces, game discovery, promotions, tournaments, loyalty/VIP areas, registration, deposits, and withdrawals.
  • Improve player journeys with a focus on usability, engagement, retention, and conversion.
  • Build and maintain scalable design systems, UI components, typography, iconography, and reusable design patterns.
  • Create responsive designs that deliver a consistent experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Development, Marketing, CRM, and other teams from concept through implementation.
  • Work with developers to ensure accurate implementation and maintain high visual quality.
  • Use research, analytics, user feedback, and product insights to identify UX improvements.
  • Continuously improve existing interfaces through iteration, testing, and optimization.
  • Stay current with iGaming design trends, competitor products, UX best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Design with accessibility, responsible gaming principles, and market-specific requirements in mind.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of UI/UX or Product Design experience, preferably within iGaming, gaming, fintech, entertainment, or another fast-paced digital product environment.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating polished UI design and thoughtful UX problem-solving.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout, prototyping, and design systems.
  • Strong understanding of responsive and mobile-first design.
  • Excellent knowledge of typography, spacing, grids, color, hierarchy, and interaction design.
  • Experience translating complex product requirements into simple, intuitive user experiences.
  • Good understanding of user journeys, conversion funnels, and usability principles.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers and understand technical constraints.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain consistency across large products.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

iGaming Experience — Strong Advantage

Experience designing any of the following will be highly valued:

  • Online Casino & Live Casino
  • Sportsbook & Sports Betting
  • Slots and Game Lobbies
  • Registration & KYC flows
  • Deposits, Withdrawals & Payment UX
  • Bonuses & Promotions
  • VIP & Loyalty Programs
  • Tournaments & Gamification
  • Player Account & Wallet Experiences
  • CRM and Retention Experiences
  • Multi-brand or White-label Gaming Platforms

Nice to Have

  • Experience with A/B testing and conversion optimization.
  • Understanding of HTML/CSS and front-end development principles.
  • Experience working with analytics and behavioral tools.
  • Experience designing gamification and reward mechanics.
  • Motion design or micro-interaction experience.
  • Experience working with international or multi-market products.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and responsible gaming UX.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for more than someone who can make screens look good.
You should be able to understand player behavior, business objectives, and product requirements, then turn them into experiences that are intuitive, engaging, and commercially effective.
You care about the details, challenge weak UX, communicate your design decisions clearly, and enjoy building digital products that players genuinely enjoy using.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ondeckglobal-igaming-ui-ux-designer

title: Account Executive, Commercial (West)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Ôsaka, Japan

About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

title: Genesys Platform Program Lead
description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

About the role

Chime is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in our member support history by migrating our enterprise contact center to Genesys Cloud CX. We are seeking a Genesys Platform Lead to serve as the internal authority for this platform: ensuring the migration lands correctly and the platform continues to operate at its best long after launch. This is not a build-and-hand-off engagement; the role serves as an ongoing "watchtower" – accountable for correct configuration, rigorous governance, and continuous improvement. 

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $138,000.00 and up to $190,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Own the solution architecture for Genesys Cloud CX — defining how it's configured, integrated with our CRM, WFM, bots, and identity systems, and governed so complexity doesn't quietly accumulate over time.
  • Be the internal reviewer for every significant architectural decision made by our Systems Implementer and Managed Services Provider, validating that what gets built actually aligns with Chime's standards and long-term operating model.
  • Lead our most complex Genesys initiatives — from new AI platform integrations to major IVR redesigns — translating business and CX requirements into technically sound platform designs and keeping delivery tracks aligned across Engineering, SI, and MSP.
  • Own the Genesys vendor relationship on behalf of Operations & Member Experience: managing partner performance to contract and SLAs, escalating issues when needed, and representing Chime's operational priorities to influence the Genesys product roadmap.
  • Drive platform effectiveness through data — measuring utilization and feature adoption, identifying optimization opportunities, and building a continuous improvement roadmap that improves routing performance, cost efficiency, and operational resilience.
  • Participate in CAB (Change Advisory Board) governance as the platform technical authority, ensuring changes are architecturally sound before release and partnering with the PMO/Change/Governance team to keep things well-sequenced and safe to deploy.
  • Build institutional knowledge that outlasts any one vendor or individual — through documentation, runbooks, and architecture decision records that keep Chime genuinely independent in how we operate this platform.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 5+ years of experience in contact center platform operations, architecture, or technical program management — you've been in the weeds on real deployments, not just advised from the sidelines.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Genesys Cloud CX, including Architect (IVR/flow design), ACD routing, queue management, skills-based routing, and platform administration.
  • A track record of holding SIs or MSPs accountable — you know how to manage vendor relationships against contracts and SLAs, and you're comfortable escalating when commitments aren't being met.
  • Strong solution architecture skills: you think in integration patterns, governance frameworks, and technical standards, and you know how to design for the long term rather than just solving the problem in front of you.
  • Experience leading complex, multi-workstream technical programs with third-party implementers — you can keep dependencies untangled and prevent the kind of silent integration failures that only surface at go-live.
  • The ability to move fluidly between deep technical design and clear communication with non-technical stakeholders — translating architectural tradeoffs into language that lands with business and CX leaders.
  • Bonus points for: Genesys Cloud CX Architect Certification; experience with CCaaS migrations; familiarity with Zendesk, NICE IEX, Okta/SCIM, or bot/AI integrations; background in financial services or regulated industries; or experience with Terraform-based Genesys configuration.

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.

We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.

We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress. 

We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.

Because if we don't—who will?

What we offer for our full-time, regular employees

  • Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
  • Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
  • Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
  • Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
  • 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
  • Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
  • Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
  • Access to family planning reimbursement
  • A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress

We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.

Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: benefits@chime.com.

To learn more about how Chime collects and uses your personal information during the application process, please see the Chime Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: General Application (United Kingdom)
description:
Headquarters: United Kingdom - Remote

If you’re interested in joining Forter but don't see an opportunity that you'd like to apply to, you came to the right place! Send us your resume and some information on what you have that we need.

Since this is not a current job posting, we will not be checking it with the same frequency as our current open position. For this reason, we will not send rejection emails from this posting.

We'll keep your information on file and will reach out if we find a match! 

About Us:

Digital commerce is built on trust. At every point along the eCommerce journey, businesses must make a critical decision: Can I trust this customer? Answering this simple question accurately and instantly is powerful—it can accelerate revenue growth and strengthen a company’s connection with its customers. How do we do it? Forter was founded on the insight that it's not about what is being purchased, nor where— but who is behind the interaction.

The Forter Decision Engine finds patterns across more than one billion identities in our dataset. We isolate fraudsters and protect customers—ensuring everyone gets the experience they deserve.  Given that trust is central to how we operate, Forter is very much driven by a defined set of values. We attract remarkable talent and have retention and engagement levels that are well above benchmarks. We’re meticulous about strengthening our culture as we grow and ensuring this is an environment where people can have outsized impact.

Life as a Forterian:

We are a team of over 500 Forterians spread across 3 different continents. Our success so far in the marketplace has allowed us to achieve a total series F valuation of over $3 Billion, making us the most valuable privately-held fraud prevention company globally. Our investors include Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, March Capital, and Salesforce Ventures. 

Benefits include:

  • Competitive salary and commission plan
  • Private health insurance, including vision and dental coverage
  • Stock options
  • Generous PTO policy
  • Half day Fridays, every Friday
  • Work from home allowance
  • Annual company-wide event - Forter Week 

Forter's Applicant Privacy Policy

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/forter-general-application-united-kingdom

title: CX Partner Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

About the role

We are hiring a Partner Manager to help strengthen and scale partner-delivered operations across our global support ecosystem on the Partner Strategy and Operations team. As our Partner Manager, you will own performance governance for assigned BPO partners, helping ensure partners deliver consistent, high-quality, efficient member experiences. You will use data to diagnose performance trends, identify root causes, and drive clear action plans with internal teams and external partner leaders. You will play a hands-on role in partner governance, business reviews, escalation management, and operational initiatives that improve frontline execution and member outcomes.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $105,000.00 and up to $145,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Own performance governance for assigned Partner/BPO operations, including SLAs, quality, productivity, staffing adherence, operational efficiency, and member experience outcomes.
  • Lead daily, weekly, and monthly partner performance reviews with clear metrics, action plans, owners, timelines, and expected business impact.
  • Translate operational performance trends into root-cause insights, risk assessments, and data-backed recommendations.
  • Drive accountability with external partners by identifying performance gaps, aligning on corrective actions, and ensuring sustained follow-through.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve member and service experience, from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through execution, change management, and post-launch measurement.
  • Partner closely with Disputes Experience, Complaints, Risk, Workforce Management, Quality, Compliance, Product, Finance, Procurement, and Operations Strategy to remove blockers and improve frontline execution.
  • Develop concise, executive-ready updates that connect frontline performance, member impact, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended next steps.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Experience, Partner/Vendor Management, BPO operations, or a related operational leadership role.
  • Professional experience directly related to BPO partner management, ideally within financial services or another highly regulated environment.
  • Proven ability to own partner performance across SLAs, quality, productivity, staffing, operational efficiency, and member experience outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to identify trends, diagnose root causes, assess risks, and build clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through execution, change management, and measurement of impact.
  • Strong influence, relationship-building, and communication skills, including the ability to drive alignment and accountability without direct authority.
  • Sound business judgment, high ownership, comfort operating autonomously in ambiguity, and willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 25% of the time.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, Looker, Google Slides, Jira, or similar reporting, presentation, and project-management tools.
  • Experience in Complaints, Disputes, Escalations, Social Media support, Risk, or other specialized servicing environments is highly desired.

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team, reporting to the Regional Director. description:
Headquarters: Orlando, FL
URL: https://profitablepaintercpa.com/careers

Tax Preparer

Join Our Team

Are you an experienced tax preparer who enjoys solving problems, working with small business owners, and producing accurate, high-quality tax returns?

Join Profitable Painter CPA PLLC, a fast-growing, tech-enabled, remote-first CPA firm that exclusively serves painting contractors across the U.S. and Canada. Our mission is simple: guide painting contractors to financial prosperity.

We’re looking for a seasoned Tax Preparer who loves tax preparation, pays close attention to the details, embraces technology, and wants the stability of a year-round position with a collaborative CPA firm.

You’ll work closely with our Tax Manager and tax reviewers to prepare individual and business tax returns, communicate with clients, resolve routine tax questions, and keep returns moving efficiently through our paperless tax workflow.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare accurate and timely federal and state individual and business tax returns, including:

  • Individual returns (Form 1040), including Schedules C, E, and D/Form 8949

  • Rental property and investment reporting

  • Partnership returns (Form 1065)

  • S Corporation returns (Form 1120S)

  • C Corporation returns (Form 1120)

  • Straightforward multi-state individual and business returns

  • K-1 reporting from partnerships, S corporations, and trusts

  • Common individual tax credits and deductions

  • Basic Section 199A/QBI calculations

  • Depreciation, Section 179, and bonus depreciation

  • Basic Schedule M-1 and M-2 reconciliations

  • Review your own work for completeness, accuracy, and internal consistency before submitting returns for reviewer sign-off.

  • Identify potential issues involving shareholder or partner basis, multi-state taxation, or other areas requiring reviewer or Tax Manager involvement.

  • Research routine tax questions independently using firm resources, recognize when an issue should be escalated, and collaborate with the reviewer or Tax Manager on more complex or unusual tax matters.

  • Communicate directly with clients regarding tax questions, missing information, and outstanding documents.

  • Document client communication and maintain accurate workflow status updates within TaxDome.

  • Collaborate with tax reviewers and the Tax Manager to resolve questions and complete returns efficiently.

  • Stay current on federal and state tax law changes and participate in regular tax department meetings and training.

  • Look for opportunities to improve the efficiency and quality of our tax preparation process.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

Year-Round: This is not just a seasonal tax position. Join a growing firm with stable, ongoing work throughout the year.

Modern Tech Stack: Work in a streamlined, paperless environment using Drake Tax, TaxDome, Juno, Verito, Slack, Notion, and other technology designed to make tax preparation more efficient.

Collaborative Tax Team: Work closely with experienced reviewers and our Tax Manager rather than being left to figure everything out on your own.

Professional Growth: Receive ongoing feedback, training, and opportunities to strengthen your technical tax knowledge.

Core Values – A.C.E.:

  • Accountability: Do what you say you’ll do.

  • Collaboration: We win as a team.

  • Excellence: Always push for better—for yourself and our clients.

Mission-Driven: Help hardworking painting contractors thrive financially and build stronger businesses.

Supportive Team: We’re organized, forward-thinking, technology-focused, and genuinely care about providing an exceptional experience for our clients and teammates.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Varying Compensation (depending on experience)
    • Flat Rate per return equivalent to $12-25 USD per hour

  • Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) (U.S. Only)

  • SIMPLE IRA retirement plan with employer matching (U.S. Only)

  • Paid Time Off

  • Paid Holidays

  • Ongoing training and professional development

  • Professional, collaborative remote work environment

You’re a Great Fit If You Have:

  • 2+ years of public accounting or tax preparation experience

  • A CPA, EA, or equivalent tax preparation experience (preferred)

  • Experience preparing both individual and business tax returns, including familiarity with Forms 1040, 1065, 1120S, and 1120

  • Strong working knowledge of federal and state taxation

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively

  • Comfort learning and working with technology-based platforms and processes

  • A professional, positive, and client-focused approach

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a fully remote team

  • Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong professional communication skills

  • The ability to work a consistent schedule aligned with Eastern, Central, or Pacific U.S. business hours

  • The drive, reliability, and availability to consistently work 40–48 hours per week as business needs require 

  • A reliable high-speed internet connection and dedicated home workspace

  • The ability to maintain strict confidentiality of client and firm information

What Success Looks Like

You consistently prepare accurate, complete, and high-quality tax returns while meeting production deadlines.

You catch issues before returns reach the reviewer, incorporate feedback, and continue improving your technical skills over time.

You communicate proactively with clients and teammates, keep your workflow current, and help returns move smoothly through the preparation and review process.

Most importantly, you take pride in doing excellent work and contributing to a team that helps small business owners make smarter financial decisions.

Ready to Join Our Tax Team?

If you’re looking for a stable, fully remote tax career with a modern CPA firm that embraces technology, invests in its employees, and values quality over simply pushing returns out the door, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your tax career with Profitable Painter CPA.

Go to the link below and complete the application:

https://profitablepaintercpa.com/careers

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/profitable-painter-cpa-pllc-tax-preparer-us

description:
Headquarters: Orlando, FL
URL: https://profitablepaintercpa.com/careers

Senior Tax Preparer/Reviewer – Full-Time, Fully Remote

Join Our Team

Are you an experienced tax professional who enjoys solving complex tax issues, reviewing high-level tax work, and helping other preparers grow?

Join Profitable Painter CPA PLLC, a fast-growing, tech-enabled, remote-first CPA firm that exclusively serves painting contractors across the U.S. and Canada. Our mission is simple: guide painting contractors to financial prosperity.

We’re looking for a Senior Tax Preparer / Tax Reviewer who brings strong technical tax knowledge, takes pride in producing accurate work, and enjoys serving as a resource to both clients and teammates.

This is a full-time, fully remote, year-round position where you’ll prepare and review complex individual and business tax returns, provide technical guidance to tax preparers, communicate directly with clients, and partner closely with our Tax Manager to maintain high standards of quality, efficiency, and client service.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare and review complex federal and state individual and business tax returns, including:

    • Complex individual returns involving Schedules C, E, and D/Form 8949

    • Passive activity loss rules and Form 8582

    • At-risk limitations and rental real estate professional status

    • Section 199A/QBI calculations, including aggregation elections and SSTB limitations

    • K-1 reporting and basis tracking for partnerships, S corporations, and trusts

    • Alternative Minimum Tax and Net Investment Income Tax

    • Multi-state individual taxation, including residency, domicile, part-year and nonresident allocation, reciprocity agreements, and credits for taxes paid to other states

    • Estimated tax and safe harbor calculations, including underpayment penalty analysis

    • Partnership taxation, including inside and outside basis, capital accounts, guaranteed payments, and special allocations

    • S corporation taxation, including shareholder basis limitations, reasonable compensation, built-in gains tax, and distribution ordering rules

    • Depreciation strategy involving MACRS, Section 179, bonus depreciation, and Section 1031 like-kind exchanges

    • Multi-state business taxation, including nexus, apportionment, combined or consolidated filings, and state-specific adjustments

    • Book-to-tax reconciliations, including Schedule M-1 and M-2

    • Consolidated and multi-entity return structures

  • Perform technical reviews of tax returns prepared by other team members, identifying substantive issues related to tax treatment, entity structure, basis, multi-state taxation, and overall accuracy.

  • Research complex tax questions using primary authority, including the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury Regulations, revenue rulings, case law, and professional tax research platforms.

  • Respond to IRS and state notices, including CP2000 and underreporter notices, when assigned.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to tax preparers, helping strengthen their tax knowledge, issue-spotting, and overall quality of work.

  • Collaborate with the Tax Manager to improve tax workflows, preparation procedures, documentation, and department efficiency.

  • Promote consistency across the tax department by helping ensure firm procedures and review standards are followed.

  • Communicate directly with clients regarding complex tax matters, outstanding questions, and return results.

  • Create client review videos that clearly explain tax return results and important takeaways.

  • Maintain thorough client communication and workflow documentation within TaxDome.

  • Attend regular tax department meetings, provide workflow updates, and communicate proactively regarding return status and technical issues.

  • Stay current on federal and state tax law changes and identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, and the client experience.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

Full-Time & Year-Round: This is not a seasonal tax position. Join a growing firm with stable, ongoing work throughout the year.

Technical Leadership: Use your tax expertise to solve complex issues, review the work of other professionals, and help strengthen the entire tax team.

Modern Tech Stack: Work in a streamlined, paperless environment using Drake Tax, TaxDome, Juno, Verito, Slack, Notion, and other technology designed to make tax preparation and review more efficient.

Collaborative Tax Team: Work closely with preparers, reviewers, and our Tax Manager in an environment where technical questions are discussed openly and quality is a shared responsibility.

Professional Growth: Continue developing your expertise through challenging tax work, ongoing training, collaboration, and exposure to increasingly complex tax matters.

Core Values – A.C.E.:

  • Accountability: Do what you say you’ll do.

  • Collaboration: We win as a team.

  • Excellence: Always push for better—for yourself and our clients.

Mission-Driven: Help hardworking painting contractors thrive financially and build stronger businesses.

Supportive Team: We’re organized, forward-thinking, technology-focused, and genuinely care about providing an exceptional experience for our clients and teammates.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) (U.S. Only)

  • SIMPLE IRA retirement plan with employer matching (U.S. Only)

  • Paid Time Off

  • Ongoing training and professional development

  • A CPA or EA designation (strongly preferred)

  • Strong working knowledge of federal and multi-state taxation

  • Strong tax research, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including experience researching complex issues using authoritative tax resources

  • Experience responding to IRS and state tax notices

  • Demonstrated experience performing technical tax reviews and identifying substantive issues beyond software diagnostics and e-file checks

  • Experience with Drake Tax review workflows and diagnostics (preferred)

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, and providing technical guidance to other tax professionals

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deadlines

  • A professional, collaborative, and client-focused approach, with the ability to work independently as part of a fully remote team

  • Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong professional communication skills

  • The ability to work a consistent schedule aligned with Eastern, Central, or Pacific U.S. business hours

  • The drive, reliability, and availability to consistently work 40–48 hours per week as business needs require 

  • A reliable high-speed internet connection and dedicated home workspace

  • The ability to maintain strict confidentiality of client and firm information

What Success Looks Like

description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

CSQ326R35

AI Engineer - FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer)

Mission

The AI Forward Deployed Engineering (AI FDE) team is a highly specialized customer-facing AI team at Databricks. We deliver professional services engagements to help our customers build and productionize first-of-its-kind AI applications. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations, as well as support internal subject matter expert (SME) teams. We view our team as an ensemble: we look for individuals with strong, unique specializations to improve the overall strength of the team. This team is the right fit for you if you love working with customers, teammates, and fueling your curiosity for the latest trends in GenAI, LLMOps, and ML more broadly. Open to remote locations.

The impact you will have:

  • Develop cutting-edge GenAI solutions, incorporating the latest techniques from Databricks AI research to solve customer problems
  • Own production rollouts of consumer and internally facing GenAI applications
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers across a variety of domains
  • Present at conferences such as Data + AI Summit, recognized as a thought leader internally and externally
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to influence priorities and shape the product roadmap 

What we look for:

  • Experience building GenAI applications, including RAG, multi-agent systems, Text2SQL, fine-tuning, etc., with tools such as HuggingFace, LangChain, and DSPy
  • Expertise in deploying production-grade GenAI applications, including evaluation and optimizations 
  • Extensive years of hands-on industry data science experience, leveraging common machine learning and data science tools, i.e. pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, etc.
  • Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike
  • Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through AI
  • [Preferred] Experience using the Databricks Intelligence Platform and Apache Spark™ to process large-scale distributed datasets
  • Willing to travel once every 4-8 weeks to see customers (as needed)

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

Summary 

We’re looking for our next Enterprise Account Manager (aka Digital Transformation Advisor) to join the Expansion Sales team and support our Northeast Enterprise portfolio. In this role, you’ll partner with CFOs and finance leaders to transform their finance landscape through cutting-edge technology. Your goal is to not only drive customer success, but also deepen strategic relationships, expand our client portfolio, and generate revenue.

We’re looking for people who embody HighRadian DNA: resilient, results-driven, skilled in stakeholder management, and energized by a fast-paced environment.

Location: This is a strategic field-based position dedicated to our Northeast Enterprise portfolio. To enable high-touch customer engagement and regular in-person meetings with key stakeholders, candidates must maintain their primary residence within the Northeast region, including New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, and New Hampshire. Regular travel to customer sites is expected.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build relationships with executive leaders and key client stakeholders to drive high levels of satisfaction and product adoption
  • Conduct assessments to understand customer pain points and develop a roadmap and business cases for customers' finance transformation using HighRadius solutions. 
  • Achieve monthly sales targets consistently. Manage and forecast sales activity and opportunities by flawlessly executing the HighRadius sales process and playbook
  • Partner with internal HighRadius teams in coordinating communication and action plans to drive desired outcomes for customers
  • Attend in-person meetings on client site, as well as industry events, such as user groups, trade shows, and conferences to build and manage relationships with prospective and existing customer base

Perks & Benefits:

Location: Remote (required to live in one of the following states: AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, MI, MN, NY, NC, TX, UT,VT)

title: Customer Success Manager (UK)
description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://coaching.com

Customer Success Manager (UK)

General Information

Department

Customer Success

Reports to

Director of Customer Success

Location

Remote, UK

Start Date

Immediate

Compensation

£55,000 - £60,000 + quarterly performance bonus*

 

About Coaching.com

Coaching.com is the platform powering the global coaching industry.

Our technology helps organizations, coaching companies, and professional coaches manage and scale coaching, from program administration and coach management to participant engagement, reporting, and more.

We work with leading organizations and coaching providers around the world to make high-quality coaching easier to deliver, manage, and scale.

The Role

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded Customer Success Manager to own and strengthen relationships with our Enterprise customers and strategic partners.

You will guide customers from onboarding and implementation through adoption, ongoing success, renewal, and expansion. Your goal is not simply to help customers use the Coaching.com platform. It is to understand what they are trying to accomplish and help them use our technology successfully to achieve it.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders at leading organizations and coaching companies, becoming a trusted partner who understands their goals, anticipates challenges, identifies opportunities, and ensures they receive meaningful value from Coaching.com.

This is an opportunity for someone who loves the intersection of technology, relationships, problem-solving, and business growth and wants to help shape an evolving Customer Success function within a growing SaaS organization.

What You'll Own

Customer Relationships & Success

  • Serve as the primary strategic point of contact for a portfolio of Enterprise customers and partners.

  • Develop a strong understanding of each customer's goals, use cases, stakeholders, and measures of success.

  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including senior and executive-level leaders.

  • Proactively guide customers toward stronger adoption, engagement, and outcomes throughout their lifecycle.

Onboarding, Training & Adoption

  • Lead customer onboarding and platform implementation to create a strong first experience with Coaching.com.

  • Deliver engaging virtual training, demonstrations, and enablement sessions for administrators and stakeholders.

  • Help customers translate their business needs into effective platform workflows and practices.

  • Monitor adoption and proactively identify opportunities to help customers gain greater value from the platform.

Retention & Account Growth

  • Own customer health and proactively identify risks before they become renewal concerns.

  • Partner with customers throughout the lifecycle to support strong retention and successful renewals.

  • Identify opportunities for account expansion, additional platform usage, and relevant Coaching.com solutions.

  • Work collaboratively with Sales and internal teams to support expansion and cross-sell opportunities.



Customer Advocacy & Product Partnership

  • Represent the voice of the customer internally.

  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback, needs, and recurring challenges.

  • Partner closely with Product, Support, Sales, and other teams to improve both the platform and overall customer experience.

  • Help identify patterns and opportunities that can improve the experience across the broader customer base.

Customer Success Excellence

  • Maintain accurate account information, activity, opportunities, risks, and next steps within our CRM and Customer Success systems.

  • Use customer data, engagement signals, and business context to prioritize proactive outreach.

  • Contribute to scalable Customer Success processes, resources, webinars, and customer education.

  • Help us continually improve how Coaching.com delivers an exceptional customer experience.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role within a technology or SaaS organization.

  • Experience managing ongoing B2B customer relationships, ideally including Enterprise accounts.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence communicating with senior and executive-level stakeholders.

  • Excellent presentation, facilitation, and virtual communication skills.

  • Ability to learn technology quickly and confidently guide customers through software workflows and solutions.

  • Strong commercial awareness with an understanding of retention, expansion, churn, adoption, and account health.

  • Proactive and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple customers, priorities, and projects simultaneously.

  • Comfortable using data and customer insights to identify risks and opportunities.

  • Experience with CRM and customer communication platforms such as HubSpot and Intercom.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and team members take ownership beyond narrowly defined responsibilities.

  • A genuine desire to become an expert in the Coaching.com platform and a trusted resource for customers.

  • Self-directed and resourceful. You do not wait for a customer problem to become urgent before taking action.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with Enterprise SaaS customers.

  • Experience in HRTech, Learning & Development, coaching, talent development, or professional services.

  • Experience working successfully within a distributed or remote team.

  • Experience supporting software implementations, onboarding, or change management.

How We Define Success

Success in this role means your customers are not simply using Coaching.com. They are getting measurable value from it.

You will help drive:

  • Strong customer adoption and engagement

  • Successful onboarding and implementation

  • Healthy Enterprise relationships

  • High retention and renewal rates

  • Identification of expansion opportunities

  • Strong customer advocacy and satisfaction

  • Clear, actionable customer insights that improve our product and experience

How to Apply

Please send the following to careers@coaching.com with the subject line Customer Success Manager - UK:

  1. Your resume

  2. A short cover letter
    In 2 to 3 paragraphs, tell us why you are interested in Coaching.com and what makes you a strong fit for this position.

  3. A short video introduction

Part of this role involves interacting with senior executives, Enterprise partners, and prospective clients, primarily through virtual meetings. You should be confident, professional, and comfortable communicating on camera.

Please record a short video of approximately 2 minutes answering the following questions:

  • What is one thing you've learned about Coaching.com that stood out to you?

  • Why are you excited about this opportunity?

  • What strengths or experience would you bring that would help you succeed in this role?

Upload your video to Google Drive and include a shareable link with your application. Please confirm that the sharing permissions allow our team to view it.

Equal Opportunity

Coaching.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, competence, and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, national origin or ethnicity, veteran status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/coaching-com-customer-success-manager-uk

description:
Headquarters: Arizona, United States
URL: https://allmyclinics.com/

Position Summary:

The Behavioral Health Integration Specialist provides non-clinical administrative and documentation support for CareLock LLC’s Behavioral Health Integration (BHI) program. This is a non-clinical, administrative position with no direct patient contact. The primary focus of this role is reviewing patient charts, completing and maintaining BHI documentation, tracking required information, supporting care-plan documentation, and ensuring all records are complete, accurate, and compliant with established CareLock workflows, AZDHS regulations, and HIPAA standards.

Key Responsibilities:

 

·         Review patient charts for BHI documentation requirements.

·         Complete and maintain accurate BHI documentation within the EHR.

·         Review existing clinical documentation and ensure applicable information is accurately reflected in BHI records.

·         Maintain and update BHI care-management documentation and care plans based on information contained within the medical record.

·         Review documentation related to behavioral health screenings, including PHQ-9 and GAD-7, when applicable.

·         Track required BHI documentation and identify incomplete or outstanding charting.

We’re looking for a video editor to help create sharp, premium LinkedIn videos about A/B testing, CRO, landing pages, and design.

title: Automation Engineer (UIPath) for innovative AI Project
description:
Headquarters:

📌 Summary

We are seeking a hands-on, execution-focused Senior Automation & AI Systems Developer (UiPath & Power Platform) to build, scale, and maintain enterprise automations across our client's regional operations. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development lifecycle for production-grade bots on a mature estate, while actively expanding into cutting-edge AI-assisted and agentic automation patterns.

This position balances rigorous build and production support work on a high-volume platform with a genuine, applied pathway into modern AI engineering. Working across UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform, Anthropic Claude, and REST APIs, you will build complex bot architectures, integrate language models, and construct resilient, multi-system workflows.

🏢 General Information (About the Client)

Our client operates a mature, enterprise-scale Center of Excellence (CoE) running a robust production estate—executing over 19,000 monthly jobs across 125+ unattended production robots and 200+ active automations.

Operating within a modern tech environment utilizing UiPath, Power Platform, Anthropic Claude, ServiceNow, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps, they are actively advancing from traditional UI-level RPA into agentic automation patterns. They foster a disciplined, engineering-first culture that prioritizes reusable code libraries, structured exception handling, robust CI/CD practices, and strict compliance-ready documentation.

Tasks and Deliverables

Production Automation Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy resilient, production-grade automations primarily on UiPath across core business lines.

Complex Architecture Engineering: Build and maintain advanced bot architectures incorporating multi-system integrations, structured exception handling, retry logic, and automated recovery patterns.

AI & Agentic Service Composition: Integrate AI capabilities directly into automation workflows, utilizing Anthropic Claude, Document Understanding, classification models, and structured LLM prompts.

Power Platform Back-End Integration: Construct and support modern user interfaces using Power Apps / Power Automate backed by robust UiPath and API execution engines.

API & Scripting Extensions: Extend automation capabilities beyond basic UI automation by writing custom Python, PowerShell, REST API, and webhook integrations.

Production Support & Incident Triage: Troubleshoot and resolve production bot failures with minimal downtime, managing queues, analyzing logs, and working closely with architects.

Code Quality & Governance: Contribute to reusable component libraries, conduct peer code reviews against team standards, and maintain audit-ready technical documentation.

Required Experience

UiPath Engineering Seniority: 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on RPA development experience with UiPath as your primary platform.

Production-Grade Bot Experience: Proven track record building and supporting automations running live in production—demonstrating deep mastery of exception handling, logging, error recovery, and multi-system integration (training exercises/POCs do not qualify).

Database & SQL Proficiency: Practical experience writing SQL queries for data manipulation, extraction, and validation within automated pipelines.

Active UiPath Certification: Hold a current, active UiPath developer credential (e.g., Automation Developer Professional, Automation Developer Associate, Specialized AI Professional, or valid Advanced RPA Developer / UiARD).

Agile Delivery Practice: Demonstrated experience delivering software within an Agile framework (daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog grooming).

Preferred Qualifications (Plus):

Practical Python or PowerShell scripting for advanced orchestration, data manipulation, and custom API connections.

Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), REST APIs, webhooks, or AI-assisted development tools (UiPath Autopilot, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude).

Exposure to agentic automation patterns, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), process/task mining, or secondary RPA platforms (Automation Anywhere).

Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps/Jira, and enterprise systems (Microsoft Dynamics 365, Workday, Salesforce, Vertafore, or Oracle Fusion).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-automation-engineer-uipath-for-innovative-ai-project

title: Course Director: UX, UI, and AI
description:
Headquarters: Denmark
URL: https://ixdf.org/about/careers

You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire. The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name the ten leading designers who should be teaching the world’s best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads at Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heights and make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers. This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the world’s leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, our other Course Directors, and the Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look at where design and AI are heading, what designers need that nobody has taught well yet, and what we should retire because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it. You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach. The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the courses our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved. You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You're one of the people whose judgment the rest of the team leans on. You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertise to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session. Timelines vary enormously: with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what matters as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience. Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Give the video team constructive feedback on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective.

  • Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world. You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On average we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Expect to have several courses moving at once at different stages: one you're planning with an expert, one being shot, one in production, and one published course that you're reviewing and improving.

  • Find room for improvement by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentation so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • We're proud to have assembled a remarkable team of unicorns who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You have at least 10 years of hands-on design experience. Thirty is not too many.

  • You have a network among designers you respect, and you're comfortable writing to someone you admire and presenting them with an opportunity.

  • You know what the design community wants to see, and what it needs to learn.

  • You're kind, and you have the social intelligence and empathy to engage well with very different kinds of people. Much of this job is convincing busy, accomplished people that what we're building is worth their time.

  • You can show us something you built or led: a product, a design team, a course, an AI teaching app, or a conference track. We're excited to hear what it was, your thinking behind it, how long it took you to create, what went wrong, and how you improved it.

  • You can take a broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequence that'll make a beginner feel and act confident. You can look at a plan for teaching something and see what's missing before anyone builds it.

  • You're a practical idealist. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

  • You’re a forward thinker who isn’t afraid to innovate and try new things before others have.

  • You collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to take human leadership, so the outcome is 100% yours and better than you could have created without AI.

  • You’re eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know they’re more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You can teach a career changer the powerful skills of great design, and you can guide an experienced designer in upskilling. Perhaps you've mentored people, or you’ve run your own company helping clients level up.

  • You give constructive feedback people can act on, and you can tell a talented colleague how they can improve their work without them becoming defensive.

  • You're genuinely curious about how AI is changing design work and design education.

  • You're fluent in written and spoken English and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

  • You’re enthusiastic about learning by doing and are committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • You spot problems before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back... [Description truncated]

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective.

We’re a flexible team, and you’ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Education Designer, establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course. You create the sequences, exercises, templates, and assessments. You'll work closely with our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and the Course Directors, who lead on what we teach and who teaches it, and you'll have a real say in both. We all reach out to and collaborate with industry leaders in these processes. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience. Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, you'll teach both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Make an impact as you decide how the courses you lead come together. You establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course, then you plan, structure, and create the core content that gets them there. What comes first, what builds on what, and how people level up step by step with ease and joy from confused to competent. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design the exercises, portfolio activities, design templates, and assessments that turn passive watching into active designing. You write the exercises that make a course participant apply an idea to their own portfolio project, the templates that scaffold that work, and the assessments that reveal whether they understood and can apply it, or whether they just watched. You write the headings and hooks your structure calls for, and our Course Writers and Editors own the final wording. Every course should leave a participant with a portfolio case study they can show a hiring manager.

  • Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests.

  • Make expert knowledge understandable. You take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches timeless human-centered design and AI.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Course Directors and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • You plan the course content in collaboration with the global industry leaders in design and then fly out to meet them in professional studios across the world. You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On average we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Our courses combine written and video lessons. You'll work closely with the video team, giving constructive feedback on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective. You'll also work closely with our growth team.

  • Balance the big picture with the smaller details. Expect to focus on one large course creation project per quarter, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published.

  • Find room for improvement by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentation so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • You won't do this alone. You'll work with our Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the structure: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether it holds together. That kind of judgment takes twenty years to build, and this type of collaboration is one of the fastest ways to grow your own design skills. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • We’re committed to excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role is not for the average. Ahead of you is a highly rewarding and enriching journey.

  • We're proud to have assembled a remarkable team of unicorns who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You have at least 5 years of hands-on design experience.

  • You've facilitated workshops repeatedly, run a beginner course, mentored designers, or built curricula for online courses.

  • You can show us something you built: a course, a workshop series, live Master Classes, an AI teaching app, or a mentoring program. We’re excited to hear what it was, why you built it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

  • You can take a broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequence that’ll make a beginner feel and act confident.

  • You can teach the same idea in different formats: a 60-minute workshop, a written lesson, a 90-second video. You know what a medium does well and what it can't carry, and you know what to cut when the format gets shorter.

  • You’re driven by the desire to make a positive impact in the world and to improve the lives of others.

  • Most of the work happens from your home office, but you're willing to travel a few times a year to shoot courses. You're located in a time zone between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

title: Associate Account Manager, SLED
description:
Headquarters: Remote, US

Description

Keeper is hiring a driven SLED (state, local, and higher education) focused Associate Account Manager to join a high producing team within our B2B sales division. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and gain valuable skills while expanding and developing client relationships in this pivotal role!

About Keeper Security

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of state, local and educational (SLED) IT environments.
